summary: BUG-0168: Isolate eligible NFS access probes while preserving full root-squash fallback. API impact: existing contract.

guide.reason: Internal probe placement only; existing operator workflow and root-squash full-probe behavior remain unchanged.

api.reason: API impact: existing contract. Native QEMU access validation retains current Controller/Core and client-facing operations, schemas, authorization and result semantics; no new resource or setting.

roadmap.reason: Reliability correction within the current storage milestone; acceptance remains open.

state.reason: Per-Core empty probe leaves are regenerable artifacts, not durable pool state or cached health. Existing Core-owned records and adoption remain authoritative.

verification.method: The old GFS-only selector failed the focused NFS placement regression. Fixed placement/owner-fallback checks and full vmhost/agent normal and race suites passed. Independent source review, native candidate-bound NFS proof on all three Cores, six-guest writes/reboot hashes/lock exclusion/preservation/cleanup and a 150-sample healthy observation passed. Root-squash fallback remains unit-tested, not a new native root-squash walkthrough. The separate unattributed post-GFS/SMB-startup repository deadlines remain under investigation.
